item.blurb: Verso Raises $6M Seed. Verso raises $6M in seed funding led by Angular Ventures to scale its AI-powered consumer intelligence platform and expand internationally.
Egoist Machines Raises $3M Seed. Egoist Machines raises $3M seed round to scale its AI Passport, a permission-based platform allowing users to manage and port personal data across AI apps.
Desible.ai Raises $3.3M Seed Extension. Desible.ai raises $3.3 million in a seed extension round led by Prime Venture Partners to scale its agentic AI workflow platform for the BFSI sector.
AblePay Health Raises $20M Series A. AblePay Health raises $20M Series A led by F-Prime to scale its healthcare affordability and patient payment engagement technology platform.
ByteXL Raises $9M Series B. ByteXL raises $9 million in a Series B round led by Elevar Equity to expand its B2B edtech platform and invest in AI-enabled learning tools.

ElevenLabs, ICEYE backer Endeavor Catalyst closes oversubscribed $320M Fund V. Endeavor Catalyst has closed its oversubscribed $320 million Fund V, taking the venture platform’s assets under management above…
Agentiq Raises $4M in Funding. Agentiq raises $4M in funding led by defy.vc to launch its fintech platform allowing fans to invest in professional athletes careers.
QualityLine Raises Strategic Investment. QualityLine receives a strategic investment from Circuit Check to integrate its AI-powered manufacturing analytics platform into automated test systems.
CloudsineAI Secures Majority Investment. CloudsineAI receives a strategic majority investment from V-Key to enhance AI cybersecurity and identity governance infrastructure.
